Discover Spray Dried Aloe Vera Powder

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried aloe vera powder for food, beverage and cosmetic manufacturers abroad. The powder is made from aloe vera inner leaf gel, which is spray dried into a fine, free-flowing form that is easy to reconstitute in water. As an aloe vera powder exporter in Surat, India, we supply brands that need a consistent dry aloe ingredient. Buyers looking for a bulk aloe vera powder supplier india can order from 5 Kg upwards. Our wholesale aloe vera powder suits drink mixes, creams and supplement blends. Whether you need an aloe vera powder supplier for a standard grade or a partner for private label packing, we can help. Buyers who search for aloe vera freeze dried powder bulk often find our spray dried grade a practical choice, since it dissolves readily and stores well. We handle every step from raw material selection to export packing.

How Our Aloe Vera Powder Is Made

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers of mature aloe vera leaves. First, the leaves are washed and filleted to separate the inner leaf gel. The gel is then filtered and heat treated. Next, spray dryers turn the liquid into a fine powder in a short drying cycle. This controlled drying gives a light, free-flowing powder with even particle size. Each batch is checked for colour, solubility and moisture before packing.

Quality and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our team follows food hygiene practices during processing and packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, so you can review mesh, moisture and shelf life before you order. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We also give export documentation support for each shipment, helping your consignment clear customs in your market.

Versatile Industry Applications

Spray dried aloe vera powder is used across several industries. Beverage makers add it to juice blends and functional drinks. Cosmetic brands use it in creams, lotions and gels. Supplement companies put it into capsules and powder blends. Food processors also use it in dry mixes and ready-to-drink formats.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Storage Conditions

We pack the powder in food-grade, moisture-resistant and tamper-evident materials. Standard export packing is HDPE drums with inner polyethylene liners. Smaller packs such as stand-up pouches and PET jars are available for private label brands. Stored in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight, the powder has a shelf life of 24 months.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried aloe vera powder?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger bulk orders and private label runs are quoted to suit your packing and freight needs.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

We are an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. A specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer retail and bulk pack sizes, from small pouches up to export drums. The shelf life is 24 months when stored correctly.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our powder is spray dried, with an 80-100 mesh particle size and moisture at or below 5.0%. Full details, including any carrier used, are listed on the specification sheet.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on order volume and packing, and we confirm it on the quotation. You can request a quote or sample by contacting our sales team through our website.
